subject: 🎯 Stock Finder: Tue Aug 11 shortlist | thin day — 3 candidates, ZBRA the standout
html_body:
🎯 Stock Finder — Momentum Discovery

Tuesday, August 11, 2026 — Kuwait time

Thin day — 3 of ~20 raw names cleared all 4 gates

The large-cap earnings-pop lane (CAT, Bloom Energy, SanDisk) all failed IBKR confirmation — every one is 20-46% off its 52-week high despite bullish search headlines, meaning the pop already faded. ZBRA is the exception: still grinding to new highs 5 sessions after its earnings breakout. Two small caps (WLDN, PLSE) back it up with real, fresh, non-binary catalysts.

🚨 Still unresolved from today's daily check — fix before adding anything below

GOOG (0.3 sh @ $368.16 avg, confirmed filled) still has no stop-limit order — flagged 2 days running by the daily check (Aug 10 and again this morning). That's the same gap that turned CAPR's stop into a −72% fill. This takes priority over any new entry below. Live IBKR right now: net liq $538.06, cash $431.56, stock value $106.50 (unrealized P&L −$3.95, consistent with the GOOG fill). AXTI (2 sh @ $58) and SPXC (0.5 sh @ $200) remain open/unfilled GTC buys that would claim ~$216 more if triggered. Sizing below uses the $538 net-liq base — re-check free cash in IBKR before placing anything, and count GOOG toward your 5-7 concurrent positions once its stop is fixed.

Momentum Shortlist

~20 raw tickers surfaced across 25 web searches + IBKR topic scans. 3 cleared all 4 gates (live-momentum, liquidity/sizing, exclusions/halal, room-left). Run analyze [TICKER] on any name for the full deep dive.
#1 — ZBRA Zebra Technologies ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5
Tech / Enterprise Mobile Computing · LARGE CAP

Signal: Beat Q2 EPS by 46% and raised full-year guidance 13% on Aug 4 — stock gapped +26.5% that day and has kept grinding to fresh 52-week highs every session since (Aug 4 → Aug 10: $291 → $378). This is continuation, not a one-day pop already priced in.

Price: $378.08 (IBKR, Aug 10 close) | Avg daily $ vol: $370.9M | RS vs SPY: outperforming clearly — +29% in 5 sessions vs a flat-to-up tape.

Why it's interesting: Duplicate-source signal — showed up independently in both the large-cap-earnings lane and the 52-week-high lane. AI-driven warehouse/workflow modernization narrative (Oxford Economics research) is layering onto the earnings beat, and analysts are still raising targets. Liquidity is a non-issue at $371M/day.

Realistic near-term target: +4-7% over 3-6 trading days — no overhead resistance (it's making new highs), next psychological levels $390/$400.

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET near the last close — not extended relative to its own breakout, still inside the post-earnings uptrend channel.

Order plan (GTC): BUY limit $379.00 · stop-limit trigger $372.50 / limit $371.00 (below Aug 10's low $373.38, the most recent higher-low) · TP1 sell limit $395.00 (+4.2%) · TP2 $405.00 (+6.9%) · size 0.214 sh ≈ $81 (~15% of $538 net liq) · R:R ≈ 2.5:1
Event window: earnings behind it ✅ Halal: ✅ Verified · Defense: ✅ Clear

Sizing note: fractional shares required (IBKR supports it — confirmed working on prior fills); ~$2 round-trip commission is ~2.5% of this position, factored into the ≥5% TP targets above.

Next step: analyze ZBRA
#2 — PLSE Pulse Biosciences ⭐⭐⭐⭐ 4/5
Medical Devices (bioelectric ablation) · SMALL CAP

Signal: Q2 results Aug 6 + an operational update Aug 7 — enrollment in the pivotal NANOPULSE-AF catheter study passed the halfway mark ahead of schedule (completion now targeted 3 months early). Stock hit a fresh 52-week high of $45.90 intraday Aug 7 on the news, now consolidating.

Price: $41.51 (IBKR, Aug 10 close) | Avg daily $ vol: $15.5M | RS vs SPY: outperforming — 9.6% off an all-time high made 2 sessions ago.

Why it's interesting: This is a clinical-progress catalyst, not a dated FDA decision — no PDUFA/AdCom risk attached. Insiders bought $13.3M in the past 3 months with zero sales, a genuine smart-money signal layered on top of the operational news.

Realistic near-term target: +8-11% over 3-8 trading days — retest of the $45.90 high, then room toward $48.

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET near the last close — 2-session pullback from the high, not extended.

Order plan (GTC): BUY limit $41.75 · stop-limit trigger $40.20 / limit $39.90 (below Aug 10's low $40.68) · TP1 sell limit $45.50 (+9.0%) · TP2 $48.00 (+15.0%) · size 2 sh ≈ $83.50 (~15.5% of $538 net liq) · R:R ≈ 2.4:1
Event window: catalyst behind it ✅, no PDUFA attached Halal: ✅ Verified · Defense: ✅ Clear

Next step: analyze PLSE
#3 — WLDN Willdan Group ⭐⭐ 2/5
Energy Efficiency Consulting/Engineering · SMALL CAP

Signal: Q2 EPS of $2.07 beat consensus $1.34 by 54%, revenue +23.5% YoY, and FY26 guidance raised — shares gapped +17% on Aug 7. Now 2 sessions into a pullback ($86.24 → $82.31).

Price: $82.31 (IBKR, Aug 10 close) | Avg daily $ vol: $26.9M | RS vs SPY: outperforming, though pulling back off the pop.

Why it's interesting: Genuine room left — even after the pop, price is still 40% below its 52-week high ($137) and 19% below the 13-week high ($101.75), unlike the extended large-cap names cut below. Lowest-conviction of the three: single-source signal, no smart-money confirmation found this run — flagging honestly rather than dressing it up.

Realistic near-term target: +7-15% over 4-8 trading days — retest of the Aug 7 high ($88.72), stretch toward the 13-week high ($101.75).

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET — the 2-day pullback is the entry, not a reason to wait further.

Order plan (GTC): BUY limit $82.50 · stop-limit trigger $79.80 / limit $79.30 (below Aug 10's low $81.29 and the $80 round-number shelf) · TP1 sell limit $88.50 (+7.3%) · TP2 $95.00 (+15.2%) · size 1 sh ≈ $82.50 (~15.3% of $538 net liq) · R:R ≈ 2.2:1
Event window: earnings behind it ✅ Halal: ✅ Verified · Defense: ✅ Clear

Next step: analyze WLDN

Cut this run — showing the work

CAT — FADED vs IBKR: search said "surged 8%" on Aug 4 earnings, but live data shows it's 21.5% off its 52-week high with a tepid +0.55% overnight print — the pop already reversed.
BE (Bloom Energy) — FADED: 39% off its 52-week high despite fresh Brookfield/Nebius deal headlines; the Jul 28 earnings catalyst is priced in and the stock has been round-tripping lower for weeks.
SNDK (SanDisk) — FADED: 46% off its 52-week high despite an Aug 5 earnings beat; huge round trip already happened, today's +2% bounce isn't a fresh breakout. Also flagging: at ~$1,262/share this would need fractional sizing regardless.
STKH — FADED, textbook example of exactly why we check IBKR: search reported premarket gains of +130-152% on a U.S. retail launch. Live IBKR data shows it's already reversing −24.65% overnight. Dropped, not passed through.
CRDO (Credo) — unstable signal: Aug 10 printed a reversal candle — spiked to an intraday high of $264.50, then closed near the session low at $239.94 (a ~9% round trip). Real theme (AI optics/networking), but the day after a distribution-style reversal isn't a clean entry. Worth another look if it stabilizes.
PTGX (Protagonist Therapeutics) — excluded on principle, not weakness: sitting at a 52-week high with a real earnings beat, but rusfertide's FDA priority-review PDUFA date lands sometime in August 2026 — still pending. That's the exact binary-catalyst FDA pattern paused after CAPR (see decisions.md). Not touching it until that's resolved.
EAT (Brinker/Chili's) — excluded: sitting at a 52-week high, but Q4 earnings are due before the open tomorrow, Aug 12. Entering now means holding into a binary print — the exact gap-risk setup the strategy pivot was built to avoid. Re-check after the print for a post-earnings pullback entry.
SPCX — dropped: only a +2.4% move (too weak to matter), and SpaceX runs substantial U.S. national-security launch contracts — close enough to the defense-adjacency line that it's not worth the judgment call for such a marginal signal.
MSFT, TEAM, ABNB, NET, TJX — stale: earnings catalysts from late July are already priced in (outside the 5-trading-day freshness window), or (TJX) haven't reported yet — next print Aug 19.

🏆 Today's best setup: ZBRA

It's the only large cap that survived IBKR confirmation this run — while CAT, Bloom Energy, and SanDisk all round-tripped 20-46% off their highs despite bullish headlines, ZBRA gapped +26.5% on its Aug 4 earnings beat and has kept making new 52-week highs every session since, backed by duplicate signal sources and continued analyst target raises. Fresher and stronger than the small-cap alternatives, with liquidity that removes any exit-risk question.

Invalidation: a close back below $371 (the Aug 10 low, the most recent higher-low in the breakout structure) — that's the stop reference, not a percentage guess.

How to use this

Confirm real free cash in IBKR first (see the account flag above). Pick 1-2 names that feel interesting, run analyze [TICKER] for the full deep dive, then size to leave room for 5-7 concurrent positions — not one dominant name. This shortlist alone is a first filter, not a buy signal.

Research output, not financial advice. Past performance does not guarantee future results. Halal screen is business-activity only, per your standing definition — verify anything flagged ⚠️ before entering. Generated Tue Aug 11, 2026 — Kuwait time.
